resources.string: Black pieces hold the board, and a white knight has to give check to the black king. It may not capture a single piece — and on the harder task it may not even step on a square one of them guards.
The black pieces do not move. Not because they are asleep, but because every jump of yours would change the position and the task would turn into a game.
Give check to the black king
Rule: do not capture pieces. Attacked squares are allowed.
Rule: do not capture pieces and do not step on a square Black guards.
